parse_training_args: parse command line arguments for open_clip training with model, data, and optimizer options
get_default_optimizer_params: get default learning rate and Adam optimizer params for ViT or non-ViT models
run_training_with_args: run open_clip training by calling parse_args to get all CLI arguments as a namespace
configure_dataset_args: configure training and validation dataset paths, types, and sample counts via CLI arguments
set_distributed_training_args: set distributed training options including backend, URL, horovod, and DDP static graph
